What-If Analysis for a Single Indicator

Source: R/contributions.R
sci_what_if.Rd

Recomputes the pillar score and the SCI as if one indicator had a different score, leaving every other indicator untouched. This gives the exact SCI movement a remediation would produce, including the effect of weight redistribution when pillars are missing.

Usage

sci_what_if(evidence, indicator_id, new_score, config = sci_config_default())

Arguments

evidence

A validated evidence data.frame.

indicator_id

The indicator_id to adjust.

new_score

The hypothetical indicator score, a number in [0, 1].

config

An sci_config from sci_config_default().

Value

A list with indicator_id, indicator_domain, old_indicator_score, new_indicator_score, old_pillar_score, new_pillar_score, old_SCI, new_SCI, delta_SCI, old_band, and new_band.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sci_what_if(evidence, "Q1", new_score = 1)
} # }
